# Command-Line Help for `vault-pull`

This document contains the help content for the `vault-pull` command-line program.

**Command Overview:**

* [`vault-pull`↴](#vault-pull)

## `vault-pull`

Calls GET /v1/export/messages with Fastmail-style search, downloads attachments via GET /v1/assets/{sha256}, and writes per-conversation .jsonl files plus attachments/.

Prefer VAULT_KEY for the vault key. Prefer Message Vault → Vault Export for a GUI.

**Usage:** `vault-pull [OPTIONS] --url <URL> --key <KEY> --out <OUT>`

###### **Options:**

* `--url <URL>` — Vault base URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080)
* `--username <USERNAME>` — Vault account username (optional; resolved from the vault key)

  Default value: ``
* `--key <KEY>` — App password / Vault key (Settings → Account). Prefer VAULT_KEY env
* `--out <OUT>` — Output directory for message-ir JSONL + attachments/
* `--query <QUERY>` — Fastmail-style search query (optional)

  Default value: ``
* `--after <AFTER>` — Only messages on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD); adds after:
* `--before <BEFORE>` — Only messages before this date (YYYY-MM-DD); adds before:
* `--source <SOURCE>` — Restrict to one vault source id
* `--skip-attachments` — Skip attachment downloads
* `--page-limit <PAGE_LIMIT>` — Page size for /v1/export/messages

  Default value: `100`
* `--auth-only` — Authenticate only; do not export
